deserialize_model_from_package: deserialize a PyTorch model from a saved package dict with optional strict mode
serialize_model_to_package: serialize a PyTorch model with captured init args and state dict into a package dict
swap_model_state_temporarily: temporarily swap a PyTorch model state using a context manager and restore after
capture_init_args_kwargs: decorate a class init to capture and store args and kwargs for later serialization
log_progress_with_LogProgress: wrap an iterable with LogProgress to log periodic progress updates with speed metrics
